verdict.rationale: Unleash documents strategy variants for exposing different versions of a feature as part of A/B and multivariate testing, and its homepage claims you can experiment with flags. Nothing in the evidence shows per-variation metric analysis or winner determination; impact metrics are documented only as rollout safeguards based on error rates and latency. missing for 10: built-in experiment results/analytics comparing variations on metrics, statistical winner determination, independent or hands-on corroboration of experimentation workflows.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can run A/B and multivariate experiments on flags and see which variation wins on my metrics

citations.quote: Variants let you expose different versions of a feature to users, for example, as part of A/B and multivariate testing.
Release, experiment, and kill anything AI ships, in real time and without redeploys.
